name: MirrorDNA
description: A lightweight DNA language model with a learned tokenizer that is exactly equivariant to the reverse complement: a symmetric boundary router cuts a sequence and its reverse complement into mirror-image chunks.

attributes.access: Code, pretraining and fine-tuning scripts, and pretrained weights (weights/mirrordna-tiny, mirrordna-duplex and the augmented control) are in the GitHub repository. The checkpoints are also on Hugging Face (nirjhor123/mirrordna-tiny, nirjhor123/mirrordna-duplex, nirjhor123/chunker-rcaug).
